description: Appends media data to an XChat upload session. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

conversation_id.description: The XChat conversation the upload belongs to.

media.description: The media segment bytes: base64-encoded in JSON bodies, raw bytes in multipart bodies.

media_hash_key.description: The media hash key returned by the initialize step.

segment_index.description: The index of this segment in the upload sequence.
